title: Optimizing the Use of a Liquid Handling Robot to Conduct a High Throughput Forward Chemical Genetics Screen of Arabidopsis thaliana
protocol: Label 625 Dilution Library plates by hand to match their corresponding plate from the chemical library.
Connect flow and out flow hoses to the Multichannel Tip Wash Automated Labware Positioner (ALP) through the Console Drive to the 5 Gallon Reservoir.
Access the computer and turn on the wash pump via connection of the Device Controller to the Multichannel Tip Wash ALP.

Load Stacker 10's attached to the Stacker Carousel by hand in Hotels A - D; one box of AP96 P20 Pipette Tips in Room 1, four 96-Well V-Bottom Plates in Rooms 2 - 5 with upper plates containing stock concentrations and lower plates empty.
Load one box of AP96 P20 Pipette Tips in Room 6, and four 96-Well V-Bottom Plates in Rooms 7 - 9 with upper plates containing stock concentrations and lower plates empty.
Set up the deck by hand with a 300 mL water reservoir on P3, a 300 mL 70% EtOH bath on P7, Tip Loader ALP (TL1), and Multichannel Tip Wash ALP (TW1).
Present AP96 P20 Pipette Tips from the Stacker 10 using the operating software.
Move the presented tips to the Tip Loader ALP.
Separate all four 96-Well V-Bottom Plates on the deck, placing the bottom two on P4 and P8 and the top two on P5 and P9.
Load AP96 P20 Pipette Tips with the Tip Loader ALP onto the 96-Channel 200 µL Head.
Aspirate 90 µL from the 300 mL water reservoir and dispense into the 96-Well V-Bottom Dilution Plate on P4.
Repeat this step for the plate on P8.
Mix the chemical library plate on P5 by repetitively aspirating and dispensing 15 µL three times.
Aspirate 10 µL from the chemical library plate on P5 and dispense 10 µL into the dilution plate on P4.
Mix the solutions of the plate on P4 by repetitively aspirating and dispensing 50 µL a total of three times.
Clean the AP96 P20 Pipette Tips by aspirating and dispensing 70 µL of 70% EtOH from P7.
Wash tips in the Multichannel Tip Wash ALP by aspirating and dispensing a 110% volume of water four times.
Repeat steps for the second pair of plates on P8 and P9.
Stack the plates in the following order from bottom to top: P9, P5, P8, and P4.
Place the stack on one empty Static ALP.
Repeat steps until Room 5 in Hotel A is empty.
Move new AP96 P20 Pipette Tips to the Tip Loader ALP upon reaching Room 6, and place used tips on an empty Static ALP.
Repeat steps until Room 9 of Hotel A is empty.
Re-fill the 300 mL water reservoir by hand prior to proceeding to Hotel B.
Pause the computer program requiring user confirmation before carrying out the next step.
Ensure a full 300 mL water reservoir each time prior to proceeding to the next hotel.
Make ½ Murashige and Skoog (MS) Media with 0.1% Agar by adding 4.3 g MS Salts, 0.50 g MES, and 1.0 g Agar to 1 L DI H2O.
Adjust pH of the media to 5.7 using 5 M potassium hydroxide while monitoring with a pH probe.
Sterilize seeds by shaking them in 1% bleach and SDS between 15 and 30 min, then rinse four times with water by centrifugation.
Place sterile seeds at 4 °C from 24 hours to 7 days for vernilization.
Add seeds to media by hand at a density of 0.1 g/100 mL.
Place four 96-Well Flat-Bottom Plates in Rooms 1 and 2 of Hotel A.
Place a box of AP96 P250 Pipette Tips on the Tip Loader ALP.
Fill a 300 mL reservoir with the media-seed mixture created previously and place it on P3.
Fill another 300 mL reservoir with 70% EtOH and place it on P7.
Load AP96 P250 Pipette Tips on the 96-Channel 200 µL Head.
Aspirate 90 µL from the media-seed mixture reservoir on P3.
Dispense 90 µL into the first 96-Well Flat-Bottom Plate.
Repeat aspiration and dispensing until all eight plates contain the media-seed mixture.
Clean the AP96 P250 Pipette Tips by aspirating and dispensing 70 µL from the 70% EtOH reservoir on P7.
Wash the tips in the Multichannel Tip Wash ALP by aspirating and dispensing a volume four times, equal to or greater than their capacity with water.
Unload the tips at TL1.
Gather the plates by hand.
Load a box of AP96 P250 Pipette Tips into Room 1 of Hotel A.
Place two 96-Well V-Bottom Dilution Library Plates into Rooms 2, 4, 6, and 8.
Insert two 96 Well Flat-Bottom Screening Plates into Rooms 3, 5, 7, and 9.
Connect hoses to and from the Multichannel Tip Wash ALP to the 5 Gallon Reservoir.
Configure the deck to contain a 300 mL 70% EtOH wash reservoir at P7.
Place the media-seed reservoir on the deck at P3.
Turn on the Console Drive by connecting the Device Controller to circulate water through the Multichannel Tip Wash ALP.
Present the AP96 P250 Pipette Tip Box from Hotel A and move it to the Tip Loader ALP.
Take 96-Well V-Bottom Dilution Library Plates from Room 2 of Hotel A and place one on Static ALP P4 and one on P8.
Remove 96-Well Flat-Bottom Screening Plates from room 3 of Hotel A and position one on Static ALP P5 and one on P9.
Load AP96 P250 Pipette Tips with the Tip Loader ALP onto the 96-Channel 200 µL Head.
Mix the 96-Well V-Bottom Dilution Plate on P4 by aspirating and dispensing 50 µL three times.
Aspirate 10 µL from this plate and dispense into the 96-Well Flat-Bottom Screening Plate on P5.
Mix the solutions in the plate at P5 by aspirating and dispensing 50 µL three times.
Clean the AP96 P250 Pipette Tips with ethanol by aspirating and dispensing 70 µL of 70% EtOH from the reservoir at P7.
Wash the tips in the Multichannel Tip Wash ALP by aspirating and dispensing a 110% volume of water four times.
Repeat steps for the second 96-Well V-Bottom Dilution Library Plate (P8) and 96-Well Flat-Bottom Screening Plate (P9).
Stack the two 96-Well V-Bottom Dilution Library Plates together.
Stack the two 96-Well Flat Bottom Screening Plates together.
Move the plates to Static ALPs P1, P2, P6, P10, P11, P12, or P13.
Repeat steps 3.4 - 3.9 three times, adding diluted chemicals to screening plates a total of eight times.
Check the number of seeds in each well of the screening plates through visual confirmation.
Supplement those wells with fewer than three seeds by additional sterilized and vernalized seed.
Incubate the 96-well Flat-Bottom Screening Plates for four days in an environmental chamber at 22 °C on a 16/8 light/dark cycle in a desiccation proof container.
Visualize the 96-well Flat-Bottom Screening Plates under a dissecting microscope.
Record all aberrant phenotypes for further investigation.
